thread:
Sara Patel: quick heads-up — planning a canary rollout for the autoscaling toggles (burst, queueing, max-concurrency guardrails). goal: validate burst behavior under short spikes without affecting steady-state latency. need eng-platform + oncall eyes.

Plan (high level):
- flag: autoscale.burst_toggle.canary (scoped to canary-01 cluster)
- initial audience: 0.5% traffic -> ramp to 5% over 60m if healthy
- guardrails: max_concurrency=120, queue_depth=200, burst_multiplier=2.0
- safety: automatic rollback if error_rate > 1% OR p95 latency increases by >40% vs baseline in 10m window
- telemetry: measure 429/503 counts, p50/p95/p99 latency, queue drop rate, GPU util, and cost delta

Config snippet we will apply:
```json
{
  "flag": "autoscale.burst_toggle.canary",
  "audience": "canary-01",
  "percent": 0.5,
  "ramp": { "step_minutes": 15, "to_percent": 5 },
  "guardrails": {
    "max_concurrency": 120,
    "queue_depth": 200,
    "burst_multiplier": 2.0,
    "queue_drop_threshold": 1000
  },
  "rollback_conditions": {
    "error_rate_pct": 1.0,
    "p95_latency_increase_pct": 40
  }
}
```

Asks: please ack, call out any immediate issues (cost, capacity headroom, other side effects). oncall - will you schedule a short runbook check during the first 30m? I'll start the rollout at 17:30 UTC if no objections.

Mike Huang: quick q — do we know how this interacts with dedicated pools? i.e., can the burst multiplier cause contention on shared nodes or does it only scale within reserved capacity? also curious about expected cost delta for 5% traffic.

Deepa Rao: agreed with mike — we should pin which clusters are allowed to scale versus queue. also: which dashboards/alerts are we watching? add an alert for queue_depth > 150 sustained for 5m and for GPU util > 90% sustained 3m. can we add a temporary rollback that reduces batch size instead of full revert?

oncall-bot: synthetic-monitor scheduled: canary-01 health probe will run every 30s starting at 17:35 UTC, failure threshold=3. Alert channel: #oncall-alerts.

Leo Marquez: nit — i'd prefer 0.5% initial (safer for cold-start-related noise) and a slower ramp (15min steps) until we see stable p95. cold starts seem to spike at first minute and could trigger rollback noise.

Sara Patel: good catches — i'll update plan: initial 0.5% (changed), ramp steps 15m to 5% over 60m. add the temporary fallback option: when queue_drop_threshold exceeded twice in 10m, halve burst_multiplier and reduce percent by 50% (so safe degrade). also add the two alerts deepa requested.

Deepa Rao: also suggest adding a short preflight traffic-shaping test for 10m at 0.2% with synthetic spike (x2 qps) to validate burst logic before opening to real traffic. can we run that 30m before the main rollout?

Mike Huang: +1 to preflight. also please tag finance if cost delta > 2% on expected spend for the rollout window.

Sara Patel: will do. updated rollout config (applied):
```json
{
  "flag": "autoscale.burst_toggle.canary",
  "audience": "canary-01",
  "percent": 0.5,
  "preflight": { "synthetic_spike": true, "percent": 0.2, "duration_minutes": 10 },
  "ramp": { "step_minutes": 15, "to_percent": 5 },
  "guardrails": {
    "max_concurrency": 120,
    "queue_depth": 200,
    "burst_multiplier": 2.0,
    "queue_drop_threshold": 1000,
    "auto_degrade": { "on_hits": 2, "window_minutes": 10, "action": "halve_burst_and_percent" }
  },
  "alerts": ["queue_depth>150:5m","gpu_util>90:3m","error_rate>1:10m","p95_latency_increase>40:10m"],
  "rollback_conditions": {"error_rate_pct": 1.0, "p95_latency_increase_pct": 40}
}
```

Sara Patel: ack from me — i'll kick off preflight at 17:00 UTC, main canary start 17:30 UTC. tagging @Mike Huang @Deepa Rao @Leo Marquez for monitoring. if nobody objects in the next 10m i'll proceed. :thumbsup:

Mike Huang: watching.

Deepa Rao: watching — will add dashboards and alert links in #eng-platform-dashboards.

Leo Marquez: watching.
